comparison.objective: Candidate fractures insert tangs; record pushes a ball retainer to a stop and rolls a slide’s inner member between rollers until seated.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires impact-force regulation and fragment recovery; record requires guided insertion through rolling elements and retainer positioning.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, retained coils, and recovered tangs; record evidence specifies retainer-at-stop and seated inner member but gives no numeric tolerances or detailed failure rubric.
comparison.reason: Rail-member seating through rollers is meaningfully different from notch fracture, despite both involving alignment.
